title: Combating wildlife trade with an advanced AI solution: a collaboration between Baidu PaddlePaddle and IFAW
summary: IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and helped remove 7,853 illegal wildlife postings by mid-2024.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI Guardian uses image recognition to support monitoring of online wildlife trade. The source reports 360,000 screened images and 7,853 removed postings, followed by a broader species-detection version in November 2024. Removal is a documented protective action in the contributors’ account. The number of prevented transactions or animals protected is not established.
purpose: Identify online wildlife-trade material and support enforcement responses.

ratings.reason: IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and led to removal of 7,853 illegal wildlife postings.
Removed listings are reported, but the extent of prevented transactions or protected wildlife is unknown.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Combating wildlife trade with an advanced AI solution: a collaboration between Baidu PaddlePaddle and IFAW

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: AI Guardian supports removal of illegal wildlife listings
